scope: Minimum BSP/ioport and core-local cache/TCM controls; not full peripheral coverage.
notes: Transcribed from cited manual tables; no SVD or later FSP register sources.
Type sizes cover emitted registers, not full peripheral address windows.
ICU,DMA,DTC banks are CPU-local at identical addresses (HM §§14.2,17.1,18.1).
PFS/PMISC ports0..D per §21.2; E..G windows in Appendix3 are not advertised.
CM33 external C/S caches use R_CACHE, not SCB cache operations.
Omitted: unselected peripheral maps, sparse ELC event registers, cache test-access views.

PMU hardware presence is documented (§2.9.3 p.146), but its configurable event-counter count is not specified. PMU CMSIS definitions are intentionally outside this minimum slice, pending an authoritative count; no count or absence is fabricated.

members.name: WUPEN0
members.note: Canonical FSP 5.9 WUPEN names the first 32-bit wake-enable bank; RA8P1 calls that identical storage WUPEN0. HM §14.2.19 pp.554–556 establishes CPU-local ICU+0x1A0, 32-bit access and target wake-enable fields. The original R7FA8D1BH.h R_ICU_Type::WUPEN is vocabulary only. No sibling fields or wake sources are added; WUPEN1 stays separate.
